workingTitle: Good days have come to gaming as Ubisoft Connect will apparently no longer be required on Steam

secondary.title: Good days have come to gaming as Ubisoft Connect will apparently no longer be required on Steam
Ubisoft games on Steam may soon no longer require the pesky Connect launcher, according to an announcement post that's weirdly tough to pin down
Ubisoft Steam games to no longer require the Connect launcher, in "initial step toward a smoother and more streamlined launch experience"
Steam Users Might Finally Be Free From The Tyranny Of Ubisoft’s Hated Connect Launcher
A new Ubisoft Steam tool could lead to a launcher-free future for its games

singleSourced.context: Ubisoft explained in a Steam post - only available to owners of the game - it's testing a new "Ubisoft Connect Services Steam Tool" that keeps Connect features like cross-progression, cross-play, rewards "without requiring the Ubisoft Connect PC launcher to be installed or launched".
